records.source: The spirits are very displeased today. They will do their best to make your life difficult.
records.translation: Lubhang hindi nasisiyahan ang mga espiritu ngayon. Gagawin nila ang lahat upang pahirapan ang buhay mo.

records.source: The spirits are somewhat annoyed today. Luck will not be on your side.
records.translation: Medyo naiinis ang mga espiritu ngayon. Hindi papanig sa iyo ang suwerte.

records.source: The spirits are somewhat mildly perturbed today. Luck will not be on your side.
records.translation: Bahagyang medyo nababagabag ang mga espiritu ngayon. Hindi papanig sa iyo ang suwerte.

records.source: The spirits are joyous! Someone gave them a nice offering today, and they are very pleased.
records.translation: Masayang-masaya ang mga espiritu! May nagbigay sa kanila ng magandang handog ngayon, at tuwang-tuwa sila.

records.source: The spirits are very happy today! They will do their best to shower everyone with good fortune.
records.translation: Masayang-masaya ang mga espiritu ngayon! Gagawin nila ang lahat upang bahaginan ng magandang kapalaran ang lahat.

records.source: The spirits are in good humor today. I think you'll have a little extra luck.
records.translation: Maganda ang timpla ng mga espiritu ngayon. Sa palagay ko'y magkakaroon ka ng kaunting dagdag na suwerte.

records.source: The spirits feel neutral today. The day is in your hands.
records.translation: Walang pinapanigan ang mga espiritu ngayon. Nasa iyong mga kamay ang araw na ito.

records.source: This is rare. The spirits feel absolutely neutral today.
records.translation: Bihira ito. Talagang walang pinapanigan ang mga espiritu ngayon.
